name: Emilio Walker
life: “I set out the wardrobe cupboard so a job seeker can browse without asking.” People around the approach to Seabright Court know Emilio by a small Saturday habit. Emilio likes to watch the beach traffic thin enough for workers going the other way.
voice: I offered a loan jacket and he refused. I had forgotten what it feels like to want one thing that's yours.
appearance: Emilio is easy to recognize by short white hair and darker eyebrows and a round face with a pronounced chin. Usually dressed in a black overshirt with pearl buttons with a replacement button a shade darker than the others, Emilio squares up pieces of paper while thinking when listening.
personality: Emilio gets protective of anybody who comes into a meeting unprepared. Emilio privately wishes people would notice the amount of preparation behind this apparent ease.
agenda: To give the customer a choice between alterations and a loan.
family: Jean King is Emilio’s cousin. Emilio checks the date twice. Jean brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *Reopening at six*, Jean says, “I own the doors and the landlord owns the timer.”
connections: Jack Bellamy. They both learn why the wearer wanted to keep one personal, unfinished sleeve.

reactions.situation: Somebody offers to buy a complete suit for the applicant
reactions.response: Emilio asks the applicant whether a whole donated suit would actually be welcome.

reactions.situation: A cyclist goes down in a crowded crossing
reactions.response: Emilio stays with the rider after the people who saw the fall start drifting away.

reactions.situation: If a colleague lies to save face
reactions.response: Emilio offers one private chance to correct it before the next conversation.
